jobs.occupation: Technical Procurement Manager– Utility-scale solar and BESS
jobs.description: Do you want to lead procurement for the construction of the largest solar and battery storage projects in the Nordics? We are looking for a skilled procurement professional with a strong commercial foundation and the curiosity to understand technical solutions in depth. You are willing to dig into specifications, ask questions and work closely with engineers and suppliers to make well-informed purchasing decisions in a rapidly evolving industry. Join us and be part of an ambitious team building the energy infrastructure of tomorrow.What will you do at NYAB? As our Technical Procurement Manager, you will work at the intersection of long-term sourcing strategy and practical project delivery, leading procurement for utility-scale solar and battery energy storage system (BESS) projects. Your scope will include core components and services such as solar modules, inverters, mounting systems, transformers, batteries, subcontractors and related technical solutions. In this role, you will:     Own and develop the end-to-end procurement lifecycle, from early tendering and supplier evaluation to contracting and execution.     Lead strategic and commercial negotiations to secure competitive terms, balanced risk positions and strong contractual outcomes.     Evaluate supplier offers against technical requirements, cost, quality and delivery needs, working with engineering colleagues to clarify specifications and understand trade-offs.    Stay ahead of the market by identifying new technologies, suppliers and system solutions that strengthen our renewable energy projects and make our supply chain more resilient    Drive procurement priorities against project requirements, schedules and budgets – and make sure we deliver. You will act as our internal product owner, digging into specifications, drawings and technical documentation together with the engineering team until you know the product as well as the supplier does. About you You are a goal-oriented self-starter with the persistence to follow through and make things happen. You combine sound commercial judgment with technical curiosity and a willingness to work through details, ask questions and understand what you are buying. You remain composed during complex contractual discussions and take ownership of your commitments, combining speed with precision and going the extra mile when it matters. Along the way, you build trust with colleagues, suppliers and partners.We believe you have:     A master’s degree in engineering, preferably within electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or energy systems.     At least three years of hands-on experience in large-scale procurement projects with complex technical scopes, ideally in an EPC environment.     Experience in end-to-end sourcing, supplier management and commercial or contractual negotiations.     Strong cost awareness and the ability to manage priorities within time and budget constraints.     Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.     The willingness to travel internationally to meet suppliers and partners, and to visit project sites in Sweden and abroad. It is an advantage if you have:     Experience in construction, electrical systems, renewable energy or another technically complex project environment.     Experience procuring equipment or services for solar parks, BESS or related energy infrastructure.     Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Swedish.Why work at NYAB? NYAB's greatest strength is our drive and the pride we take in our work. We all pull in the same direction – forward. We value people for their competence and initiative, and you get the freedom to act along with the accountability that comes with it. Our entrepreneurial spirit is built on collaboration and commitment. We are a close-knit community where colleagues support one another, share knowledge and work together to find solutions when new challenges arise. You will never work alone – you will have the support of colleagues and leaders, and plenty of room to grow. We also offer:    Comprehensive health assessments     Generous wellness allowance     Parental pay supplement    Reduced working hours – (Sw: arbetstidsförkortning)    A secure pension planReady to make it happen? Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile. We review applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you. Start: As agreed   Employment type: Full-time   Location: Hägersten, Stockholm

jobs.occupation: Head chef to Mr.Bronck & Sallys at Sheraton Stockholm Hotel
jobs.description: Stockholm outside, a world of guests inside, and a kitchen ready for your ideas. It´s time to bring your flavour to Sheraton Stockholm.  Sheraton Stockholm has been bringing people together in the heart of the city since 1971. Today, we’re shaping our next chapter, with a major transformation, fresh energy and new places to eat, drink and connect. With Archer Hotel Management as our operator and Marriott International as our brand family, we combine an international outlook with a strong sense of place. Now we’re looking for a Head Chef to lead the food experience at Mr. Bronck, Sally’s and our room service operation. Someone with a clear culinary point of view, a head for business and the ability to build a team people want to be part of.  From dinner at Mr. Bronck to food that complements a cocktail at Sally’s or a great meal delivered upstairs, you’ll make sure every experience feels considered, consistent and right for the setting. You’ll lead the daily a la carte kitchen operation and develop seasonal menus that give each concept its own character. Taste, presentation and timing matter equally, and you know how to deliver all three when service picks up. Behind every great service is a well-run kitchen You’ll take ownership of menu costing, purchasing, stock control and staffing, keeping quality high and food waste low. You’ll turn business forecasts into smart schedules, maintain strong food safety and HACCP routines, and keep a close eye on the financial performance of the operation. Just as importantly, you’ll recruit, coach and develop your team. You set clear expectations, share your knowledge and stay approachable under pressure. Working closely with colleagues across the hotel, you’ll help create a seamless experience for our guests. A creative chef and a grounded leaderYou bring at least five years of experience in a similar leadership role in a quality restaurant or hotel kitchen. You’re confident developing menus, leading busy services and balancing culinary ambition with commercial results. You care about the details and understand how your decisions affect the whole operation. You bring structure, curiosity and high professional standards, and you enjoy finding practical solutions when plans change. Your team can count on you for direction, support and a steady presence during a demanding service. You communicate confidently in English; Swedish is a plus. An established network within the industry is also welcome. Make your mark on our next chapterThis is an opportunity to influence the food, develop your team and help shape the next chapter of an iconic Stockholm hotel. You’ll join an international, inclusive workplace with opportunities to grow within Sheraton and the wider Marriott family, alongside access to employee hotel rates around the world. We offer a permanent, full-time position with a six-month probationary period and terms covered by a collective bargaining agreement.Are you ready to bring your ideas to the table?Send us your application. We review applications and meet candidates throughout the recruitment process, so the position may be filled before the closing date. Let’s create something worth coming back for.

Mat4Green Tech AB (M4GT) is a Chalmers University spin-out based in Gothenburg. We develop and commercialise closed-loop processes for recovering and refining metals from industrial materials, with our own lab and pilot facilities in Gothenburg. We are now looking for a chemist who will take hands-on ownership of our recycling and purification work.About the roleYou will run and develop hydrometallurgical and electrochemical processes in our lab and pilot facility, from leaching and solvent extraction to electrolysis and final purification. You plan, build and manage your own projects: you define what equipment and materials are needed, find and negotiate with suppliers, carry purchases through, and keep the work documented and safe. You work closely with our technical team and take the process forward step by step towards industrial scale.What we are looking for    A Master's degree or higher in chemistry, chemical engineering or a related field    - A solid understanding of process chemistry, including solvent extraction and electrolysis, and of safe handling of the chemicals involved    - Experience in planning, writing up and managing technical projects    - A structured and efficient way of working, with the ability to adapt when conditions change    - The ability to find, negotiate and purchase the equipment and materials needed to carry out the job    - Fluent English; Swedish is a meritWhat we offerA key role in a technically strong team with close ties to Chalmers, a high degree of ownership, and the opportunity to take a process from the lab to industrial scale.ApplicationSend your CV and a short cover letter by e-mail. Interviews are held on a rolling basis, so apply as soon as possible.

The Plant Coordinator supports the coordination and management of plant, vehicles, tools, and assets across operations in Sweden. The role supports asset management activities, lifecycle planning, and operational asset performance. The role supports plant availability, maintenance coordination, and efficient utilisation of company assets. The role works with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and service providers to support asset management, regulatory compliance, and commercial objectives.How this role lives our values This role supports the effective management of plant and assets by helping ensure that equipment, vehicles, and resources are available, maintained, and correctly managed throughout their lifecycle. By maintaining visibility of asset performance, availability, and compliance requirements, the role supports efficient operations and informed decision-making. Safety: Support a safe working environment by helping ensure assets, vehicles, equipment, and inspection requirements are managed in accordance with company and regulatory standards. Integrity: Support accuracy, accountability, and compliance through effective record management, asset tracking, and adherence to established processes. Teamwork: Build strong working relationships that support collaboration, communication, and coordinated asset management activities. Ownership: Take responsibility for following through on actions, resolving operational issues, and supporting the effective management of company assets. Sustainability: Support long-term value creation through responsible asset management, efficient utilisation, and sustainable lifecycle practices. Key ResponsibilitiesPlant & Asset Lifecycle Management:     Coordinate plant, vehicle, tool, and asset activities throughout the asset lifecycle, including receipt, return, allocation, and disposal in line with project requirements.     Support asset management strategies and asset replacement or upgrade planning. Maintenance & Compliance Coordination:     Coordinate planned and unplanned maintenance activities, inspections, testing requirements, and equipment compliance activities.     Maintain up-to-date asset records, tracking information, and compliance documentation, including leased and hired assets. Asset Operations & Procurement Support:     Coordinate plant movements, operational requirements, procurement activities, and supplier engagement.     Support commercial decision-making relating to plant acquisition, hire, utilisation, and cost management.     Support the procurement of fuel, spare parts, and other plant-related requirements. Sustainability & Asset Optimisation:     Support effective asset utilisation, reuse, sale, recycling, and sustainability initiatives in line with the company’s sustainability strategy. Fleet & Incident Coordination:     Coordinate fleet-related incidents, repairs, and recovery activities.    Coordinate vehicle maintenance requirements in line with applicable regional requirements. Health, Safety & Regulatory Compliance:     Support compliance with safety, environmental, sustainability, regulatory, and internal company requirements. Commercial Administration:     Support the effective management of plant and asset-related costs.     Reconcile monthly invoices and account statements relating to plant and assets. Key Requirements     3rd level qualification or equivalent experience in procurement, purchasing, commercial functions, or construction plant operations.     Experience in a similar position (typically 3 years or more).     Knowledge of plant and asset management.     Knowledge of Swedish regulatory requirements and construction industry standards.     Experience using asset management systems and tools.     Analytical skills, process awareness, and attention to detail.     Communication, relationship management, and stakeholder engagement skills.     Fluent English; Swedish language skills are advantageous.     Valid Swedish or EEA driver's licence.Skills     Plant and asset management knowledge.     Regulatory compliance knowledge.     Asset management systems knowledge.     Analytical and process management skills.     Stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.     Commercial awareness. A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.It’s a plus if you have    GraphQL, Kafka or other event-streaming technologies    AWS serverless services such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB or SQS    Kubernetes, Docker and CI/CD    SQL and NoSQL databases    Experience from automotive, connected vehicles, telecom or other product-focused environments    Experience operating and improving production servicesThe mindset we’re looking forFor us, being a great engineer is about more than technical skills.We’re looking for people with a strong consulting mindset – people who understand that great consulting is about creating real value, taking ownership and being someone both the team and the client can rely on.You’re highly skilled at what you do, but you’re also a doer who cares about quality. You don’t wait for someone else to solve the problem. As Head of the Avionics & Electrical Department, you will play a central role in shaping the electrical and electronic architecture of our satellite platforms and ensuring the reliable performance of our missions. Our customers include major space companies, agencies, and commercial players across Europe and worldwide.OHB Sweden develops advanced small satellite systems for scientific and Earth observation missions. These missions require highly reliable avionics and electrical systems that form the backbone of the spacecraft, enabling power generation and distribution, communications, command and data handling, and mission operations.The Avionics & Electrical Department is responsible for the design, development, verification, and support of the satellite's electrical and electronic systems. The department currently consists of approximately 23 highly skilled engineers and specialists working in areas including:    Electrical Architecture    Electrical Power Systems (EPS)    TT&C and Communications Systems and RF Systems    EMC / EMI    Electronics Design    Radiation Engineering and EEE Component Usage    Data Handling Systems and Onboard Computers    Harness Design    FPGA Design    EGSE designThe department contributes throughout the complete spacecraft lifecycle, from early mission concepts and proposal activities, through design studies, detailed development, subsystem and system verification, launch preparation, and operational support.The space industry is evolving rapidly, driven by increased satellite autonomy, software-defined systems, miniaturized electronics, higher levels of integration, growing constellation markets, and increasing demands on cybersecurity, resilience, and manufacturability. At the same time, OHB Sweden is transitioning towards a higher degree of productization and industrialization of its satellite platforms. In this context, the Avionics & Electrical Department will play a key role in defining future platform architectures, technologies, methodologies, and engineering practices. As Head of Department, you will lead this evolution and ensure OHB Sweden remains a competitive and technically leading provider of advanced small satellite systems.As Head of the Avionics & Electrical Department, you will be mainly responsible for:    Driving staff recruitment, onboarding, and development to build a motivated and high-performing team.    Managing resource planning to balance project demands and support business growth, in close collaboration with project managers and other department heads.    Acting as a key point of contact for customers, partners, and suppliers on avionics, electrical, communications, electronics, and onboard computing matters.    Ensures that engineering processes relevant for the department activities exist and are properly implemented.    Ensures that proper engineering tools are efficiently used in the department    Owns the department ways-of-working.    Implementing strategic and operational decisions from the Company Management Team within the department.    Ensuring the department's skills and expertise align with the evolving needs of the company and its projects.    Reporting to employees and managers.    Overall responsibility for the technical deliveries from the department to the project in quality, time and cost.    Managing resource planning to balance project demands and support business growth, in close collaboration with project managers and other department heads.    Contributing to proposals by estimating costs and evaluating staffing.    Leading budgeting within your area of responsibility, covering general expenses, training, laboratories, equipment, and investments.What We're Looking For    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Engineering Physics, or a related discipline.    At least 10 years of experience as an engineer and technical leader within avionics, electronics, electrical systems, communications, or a related field.    Proven leadership skills, with experience managing teams and coordinating complex, multidisciplinary engineering activities.    Strong understanding of spacecraft avionics and electrical systems, including electrical architectures, power systems, communications, onboard computing, electronics development and testing.    Understanding of EMC, radiation effects, reliability, and engineering standards applicable to space systems.    Strong analytical skills and the ability to foster innovation and continuous improvement within the team.    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.    Fluency in English; knowledge of Swedish is a plus.    A collaborative mindset, with experience working in multicultural and multidisciplinary environments.What We Offer    A unique opportunity to lead one of the key engineering departments responsible for the core avionics and electrical capabilities of our satellite platforms.    Involvement in all phases of satellite projects, from early studies and proposal work to launch and operations.    A supportive and innovative work environment, with opportunities for personal and professional growth.    Competitive salary and benefits, with flexibility for work-life balance.The Head of Avionics & Electrical Department will report to the Head of Engineering & Technology and play a key role in the company's technical leadership team. This position may require occasional travel, primarily within Europe.Join us and help shape the next generation of satellite avionics and electrical systems!

jobs.description: Job DescriptionThe Engineering Manager (EM) is accountable for technical execution, delivery quality, and operational excellence for a defined product or service. The role partners with Product Managers in product contexts and owns delivery and roadmap in service contexts. The EM combines delivery accountability with people leadership and has the mandate to make technical decisions aligned with strategy.    ABOUT THE TEAM The Pricing Foundation Team is a global product development team at H&M Group, driving the future of pricing across our brands and markets. We bring together product, business, engineering, quality assurance, analytics, and design expertise to build scalable solutions that enable accurate, automated, and data-driven pricing decisions. Working across Stockholm and Bangalore, we collaborate closely as one team to deliver business-critical capabilities that impact millions of customers worldwide.  ABOUT THE SCOPE Our team owns the core pricing platform that powers H&M Group's global pricing operations. We are responsible for developing and evolving services that ensure consistent, scalable, and reliable pricing across brands, channels, and markets. By combining modern technology, automation, and strong business collaboration, we enable faster time to market, improved data quality, and seamless pricing experiences while supporting H&M's digital transformation journey. We're on an ambitious transformation journey, redefining how pricing works across H&M Group. For our team members, this means the opportunity to work with modern technologies, solve complex business challenges at scale, and grow alongside a product area that is shaping the future of global retail pricing.  WHO YOU ARE      Deep expertise in engineering (end-to-end development process understanding)       Deep expertise in architecture, scalable design principles and cloud fundamentals      Familiarity with automated build, test, and deployment pipelines – CI/CD & DevOps     Ability to assess and manage technical debt.       Hands-on capability to stay up to date with the technology being led       Coaching and leadership skills.       Strong communication and stakeholder management.       Experience in vendor collaboration and external partnerships.       Financial acumen – ability to manage tech budgets.       Strong understanding of agile ways of working, including continuous improvement practices.       Ability to balance technical trade-offs with business priorities.       Analytical thinking: leveraging data and insights to inform decisions.       Ability to navigate complexity and ambiguity.       Strong security & compliance skills, securing coding and regulatory awareness       Understanding of monitoring, incident management and SRE practices     And who has..      Strong in engineering and architecture expertise      Ability to manage technical debt      Strong stakeholder communication skills      Vendor collaboration experience      Financial/budget awareness      Strong agile ways of working      Security and compliance understanding      Monitoring and incident management knowledge  WHO WE ARE  H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.  We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.   WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE  At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.      Staff discount card: Usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online.      H&M Incentive Program (HIP): Included in our HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.      Competitive pensions: Collective Agreement and ITP pensions competitive to the Swedish market.      Generous vacation: 30 days' vacation, health care allowance, and good work-life balance.      Additional perks: Discounts from Benify.      Innovative Environment: Work with cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions.      Global Impact: Be part of a team that influences users worldwide.      Professional Growth: Endless opportunities to learn and develop your skills.      Collaborative Culture: Join a motivated team that values collaboration and excellence.   JOIN US  Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.  This is a full-time permanent position, starting as soon as possible according to the agreement. The role is a hybrid position, based in our office in Stockholm, Sweden.  Apply by sending in your CV in English as soon as possible. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through the career page.  Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. We are eager to meet you!  *We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.  Please apply 21 September 2026.

RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia & New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.Do you have experience in software test management and want to improve cancer care for patients around the world? Join RaySearch's development department as Verification and Validation Manager for RayCare! About the position RayCare is an innovative oncology information system designed to support clinical workflows at cancer clinics. It is developed by multiple agile teams working closely together, with expertise spanning clinical workflows, integrations, and system architecture. We develop our products in close collaboration with leading cancer clinics worldwide. As Verification and Validation Manager for RayCare, you will be part of the RaySearch Product Safety team and play a central role in ensuring product quality throughout the development lifecycle. Together with the team, you will plan, lead, and document development projects, ensuring that we deliver safe and high-quality software to our users. In this role, you will work closely with development teams, product management, and other stakeholders across the organization. The work is dynamic and cross-functional, requiring both structure and adaptability. Your main tasks     Develop, own, and continuously evolve the Verification and Validation strategy for RayCare releases.    Lead the associated V&V activities in accordance with RaySearch development and risk management processes, using a risk-based and lifecycle-oriented approach that supports product quality and regulatory compliance.     Ensure fit-for-purpose test environments, test tools, and ways of working that enable teams to implement the Verification and Validation strategy effectively.      Drive continuous improvement of V&V execution, with a particular focus on increased automation.     Create compliant V&V documentation, including test specifications, reports, and V&V summaries. Your profile We believe that you have a background as a verification and validation manager or a similar leading role within software testing. You are pragmatic in your approach and able to structure and prioritize work in a dynamic environment. You enjoy solving problems as they arise and take initiative to improve ways of working— - especially when it comes to automation and efficiency. You are comfortable coordinating across with teams and stakeholders and have strong communication skills. Requirements     BSc or MSc degree in engineering, or equivalent     5+ years of experience in verification and validation management within software development     Excellent written and spoken communication skills (English and Swedish) Meriting     Strong experience driving test automation and working with system integrations in complex environments    Experience coordinating validation usability testing and working within agile development methodologies    Background in the MedTech industry, with hands-on experience applying AI-driven and agentic testing approaches Our CultureCulture at RaySeach is the driving force behind our organization, where everything we do is driven by a shared passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our dedication is reflected in our ability to deliver exceptional results, pay close attention to detail, and consistently go the extra mile. Our employees stand out as experts in their field, driven by a relentless focus on solving problems - no matter how complex. At RaySearch, we take pride in leading the way in cancer treatment, leveraging cutting-edge technology to develop innovative solutions that make a real difference in patient care.Our OfferAt RaySearch, we offer a diverse and inclusive work environment, fostering openness, sincerity, and collaboration. Located in Hagastaden, Stockholm's Life Science Hub, our modern and creative workspace includes an in-house gym, yoga, and social activities like ping pong, table football, and regular after-work events. Our bistro serves a fantastic lunch buffet, and we offer morning- and afternoon-fika every day. Our rooftop terrace also provides a stunning 360-degree view of Stockholm, enhancing the work experience. All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package.ApplicationPlease apply to the position through the application form below. We do not accept applications by e-mail. Selection and interviews will be ongoing.

Silex Microsystems is the world’s leading pure-play MEMS foundry, customizing solutions for prominent global clients in industries such as pharmaceuticals, consumer electronics, and automotive. As a Process Engineer, you will initiate and drive progress in the Plasma Deposition area. Sounds interesting? Keep reading.Would you like to know more about Silex and what we do?The AreaThe Plasma deposition area is one of several vital departments of our production line here at Silex. Several different deposition techniques (PVD, PECVD, ALD and evaporation) are utilized to deposit thin films, ranging from various metals to dielectrics.You will work with both engineers, process operators and service technicians where collaboration is critical to ensure good process stability, tool uptime and continuous improvement.The roleYour overall responsibility is to ensure manufacturing goals are met, together with operators and service technicians. Your days will be a mix of meetings with Product Managers, developing new processes that meet customers' specifications and ensure reliable production processes.You will also participate in creating work routines for operators and solve problems that occur at the area, driving improvement projects to enhance our workflow and processes at the Plasma Deposition area.In this role, you will:    Develop, maintain and improve thin film deposition processes.    Establish, and maintain routines and documentation.    Handle stopped production batches and development material together with process integration engineers (PIs).    Be a part of creating and improving the infrastructure for operator training to make sure current routine is available and up to date.    Participate in process qualification of new equipment or materials and release them to production.    Participate in the startup of new products, review specifications and process flows.    Grow into taking responsibility for area equipment, improving the tool uptime, maintain and develop new standardized process modules.We are looking for someone who has:    A PhD degree in relevant field, or a Master’s degree combined with a couple of years of relevant industrial experience. Specializing in Nanotechnology, Microfabrication, Applied Physics or Material Science is considered as highly beneficial.    An understanding of plasma physics or semiconductor processing principles. Hands-on experience with deposition equipment, e.g. PVD, PECVD, ALD and evaporation is considered a merit.    The ability to see opportunities for improvement and manage projects to follow through with those improvements.    Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.    Strong skills in documentation and quality management    Excellent communication skills in English; proficiency in Swedish is considered a merit.What we offer you    An opportunity to work closely with talented and inspiring colleagues in a collaborative environment.    A chance to be part of a world-leading company, driving the future of MEMS technology.    The ability to engage with cutting-edge innovations that shape global industries and everyday life.    The satisfaction of contributing directly to transformative technologies at the industry’s most advanced pure-play MEMS foundry.About Silex Silex is the world’s largest and most advanced pure-play MEMS foundry, headquartered in Stockholm. MEMS technology is moving into an abundance of modern innovations; from data centers, consumer and automotive electronics to medical diagnostics and life science.The recruitment process We have an ongoing recruitment process, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. To apply, please attach your CV and answer a few brief questions. Our process is competency-based and includes a personality and logic test, reference checks, and a background check. Additionally, a drug test will be conducted prior to employment, and we perform random alcohol and drug tests for all employees.

At Embark, we are exploring what it means to build living games by choosing the smartest route while striving towards a healthy work-life balance. As a Senior Producer on ARC Raiders, you will join the game’s core leadership team, working in close partnership with the Executive Producer, production leads, and discipline leads to safeguard the quality, player sentiment, and ongoing product direction of our live game.We see game development, especially in a live environment, as a constant work in progress and a living journey. In this role, you will be a product-minded leader with a strong appetite for community engagement and external communication. While our Production Director owns studio planning, P&L, and staffing, you will focus on the "What" and "Why" and the player impact. In close collaboration with the directors, you will help assess what is best for our players, deeply understanding why we make specific choices. You will focus on product health, drive update quality, and ensure that player feedback directly informs our live strategy. You will manage expectations upward, delegate with trust, and champion creative ideas that don't just meet expectations, but actively surprise and delight our community.Examples of Responsibilities    Product Ownership & Alignment: Sit on the ARC Raiders leadership team, collaborating with the EP, production leads, and discipline leads to drive product strategy and translate vision into high-quality live updates.    Game Quality & Sentiment Ownership: Serve as the guardian for update quality, player sentiment, and product health to ensure every release, feature, and patch lands with high polish and positive player response.    Community Connection & External Communication: Partner closely with the Community Team to listen to player feedback, translate insights into actionable game updates, and help shape clear, empathetic communication directly with our community.    Living Product Mindset: Embrace the reality that a live game is under constant evolution, guiding the game's direction through iteration, community sentiment, and data-informed decision-making.    Expectation Management & Delegation: Manage product expectations upward to executive stakeholders and internally across the studio, knowing when to step in, when to delegate, and how to empower cross-functional teams.    Collaborative Problem-Solving & Delight: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with cross-functional feature teams to solve complex creative and product challenges while fostering an environment where teams are empowered to take creative risks that delight players.We would love if you have    8+ years of experience in AAA PC or console games production, including experience as a Product Owner, Senior Lead Producer, or Game Lead on a major live-service (GaaS) title.    Proven track record of owning product strategy and live quality, with a strong emphasis on player retention, community sentiment, and post-launch engagement.    Deep curiosity and understanding of game design, player motivations, understanding feedback and data, product rationale, and being able to grasp and articulate why specific choices are made for the game and community.    A strong appetite for external communication and community dynamics and are comfortable acting as a bridge between internal game development and the player base.    A mindset that views games as living software and are comfortable navigating constant change and viewing live game development as an ongoing journey.    Strong leadership presence & capability to build high-trust partnerships with production and discipline leads.    Exceptional communication skills with a focus on collaboration, empathetic player engagement, and strong collaboration & delegation habits.    Deep passion for PC/console games, competitive/co-op multiplayer ecosystems, and community dynamics. This is an on-site role, and we are only considering candidates already residing in Sweden.At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

At Umain, we're not just creating software; we're crafting the future, one innovative project at a time. With our motto "Shape, Ship, Scale," we empower our team to not only envision the future but also play a pivotal role in building it. We're a dynamic team where you can shape the future, ship groundbreaking solutions, and scale your abilities in many different ways.We're on the lookout for QA Engineers who see testing as more than checking features. You understand that the purpose of testing is to make risks visible and reduce uncertainty, and you care about improving not only the product but also how the team ensures quality.You enjoy methodical, structured testing, but you're equally curious about automation, AI-assisted tooling, and how to make testing smarter, faster, and better integrated into the delivery flow.What We Offer:    A chance to work on unique projects that explore and push the boundaries of what's possible.        A fun and fair work environment where your you have the opportunity to expand your skills through unique challenges and fantastic colleagues.        A personal coach, and a setting where you can grow professionally and personally.        Being part of multidisciplinary teams, participating in agile teams, being an important player in a highly ambitious setting.As a QA Engineer at Umain, your role will involve:    Analysing user stories and requirements to identify risks and define test cases        Design, execute, and maintain functional, regression, and exploratory tests        Build and extend automated tests for UI, API, or backend        Collaborate with developers to integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines        Report and communicate quality insights, focusing on what the results mean        Suggest and implement improvements in testing practices, tools, and processes — including leveraging AI to work smarterWhat you bringStructured and analytical testing skills    Strong understanding of structured and risk-based test design, drawing on principles from frameworks such as ISTQB or TMAP        Experience across different test levels including component, integration, system, and UAT        Ability to design, prioritise, and maintain test cases based on business impact and riskAutomation and technical mindset    Hands on experience with modern automation tools such as Cypress, Playwright, Appium or Postman        Comfortable writing basic scripts in JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python        Understanding of APIs, JSON, and CI/CD pipelines such as GitLab, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins        Treats automation as part of the product codebase, versioned, reviewed, and maintained        Actively explores how AI tools (such as GitHub Copilot, AI-assisted test generation, or LLM-based exploration) can support and enhance testing workCollaboration and communication    Works closely with developers, designers, and product owners to clarify and test assumptions early        Communicates findings clearly and constructively, focusing on understanding and action        Helps stakeholders make informed release decisions by putting risks into contextOwnership, growth and continuous improvement    Actively invests in your own development, you follow the field, experiment with new approaches, and push yourself to keep growing        Takes initiative to improve how the team works instead of waiting for others to define it    Brings ideas for smarter ways of testing or automating repetitive work        Contributes to making quality a shared team responsibilityExperience we’d love to see    3 to 6 years of experience in QA, test engineering, or a similar quality focused role        Experience working in agile, iterative delivery environments such as Scrum or Kanban        Exposure to end to end digital product development across web, mobile, or backend systems        Experience from consultancy or multi client projects is a plus        Fluent in English; other languages are an advantageWhy Umain?    Career Framework:    We believe in fairness and clarity, which is why we've established a transparent career framework to ensure equal pay and equal opportunities for all. Your growth and success are as important to us as they are to you. Together with your coach, you will build your own development plan and grow in your career.    Work-Life Balance:    At Umain, diversity is our strength. We understand that life doesn’t pause when you walk into the office. That's why we've cultivated an environment that supports an excellent work-life balance. We welcome team members from all walks of life, recognizing the richness that different backgrounds, ages, and life stages bring to our team. We're committed to supporting each other, encouraging a healthy work-life balance that respects your needs, whether it's taking care of your family, your pets, or yourself.    Innovations and Learning:    Technology is always evolving, bringing new challenges and opportunities for collaboration and learning. Our developers work closely with designers, analysts, testers and more to tackle these challenges head-on, sharing knowledge and growing together.    Skills Over Degrees:    We’re more interested in what you can do than in the diplomas you hold. Talent, drive, and creativity are what count at Umain. Here, you’ll find opportunities to grow, learn, and excel in your career, regardless of your educational background. If you have the ambition and commitment to succeed, we have the environment and resources to support your journey.Are You Ready to Shape, Ship, and Scale with Us?If you're a QA Engineer who thrives on innovation, values a supportive and inclusive workplace, and is eager to make a tangible impact on the future, we’d love to hear from you. Let’s build something awesome together.Background checkUmain conducts a background check for final candidates in accordance with our internal policies. The check is carried out only with your consent and is ordered by our CISO through our approved screening partner. The scope of the check depends on the role level. This step is performed late in the recruitment process and is used solely to support a secure and fact‑based hiring decision.

About us Ingrid was born out of a simple belief: the energy transition must move faster and work smarter. We're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving the problems that matter most.The INtelligent GRID of tomorrow needs to absorb and release more power. We develop, build and operate high-performance batteries — the lungs of modern energy infrastructure — enabling a more flexible and resilient energy supply across Europe. With 500 MW already deployed across the Nordics and rapid expansion into continental Europe, we manage, optimize and trade both our own assets and those of third parties through our sophisticated tech platform, making every battery — and the entire grid — stronger.Watch our film About the role Do you have a proven track record of bringing high-quality projects to Ready-to-Build — with a deep understanding of what it takes to develop assets that perform over their full lifetime?We are looking for an experienced and hands-on senior project developer to lead the development of our energy storage projects in the Nordics.You will become a senior team member within the project development team, taking full ownership over projects – leveraging your negotiation and execution skills based on a thorough understanding of what makes a project bankable and sound from a financing perspective.You thrive with ambiguity and have a proven track record of high-quality project deliveries while working with a wide range of stakeholders (landowners, grid owners, authorities, utilities as well as internal stakeholders –transaction, engineering, procurement). You enjoy the mix of hands-on execution, strategic planning, negotiation, independent work and collaboration. Travel within the Nordics occurs occasionally - traveling to sites for assessments, stakeholder meetings, and ensuring that development milestones are met. You will report to Head of Development. Key tasks and responsibilities:    Drive project development efforts, to secure land, permits, and grid connections to reach RtB status.    Negotiate agreements and build strong relationships with key stakeholders. Representing Ingrid at industry events, fostering strategic partnerships and collaborations.    Ensure strong financial viability and technical excellence as well as drive continuous improvements in all aspects of development.    Navigate regulatory processes and stay ahead of market trends to ensure compliance and long-term project viability.    Identify and proactively address project risks through strategic planning and problem-solving.    Oversee project documentation to ensure compliance with industry standards, and seamless project handover.    Work cross-functionally to align technical, financial, and regulatory aspects of projects to drive innovation and contribute to Ingrid’s long-term growth and success.Your work experience:    10+ years of experience in project development in renewable energy or energy storage – proven track record of projects reaching RtB, experienced with specific Nordic regulatory/permitting framework coupled with financial/bankability knowledge    University degree in engineering, business, management or related field.    Technical expertise in energy markets and understanding of grid infrastructure.    Fluency in English; additional languages are a plus.Your personal skillsIn addition to relevant work experience, we’re looking for someone with the right personal skills and motivation, and a genuine passion for renewable energy.    Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels.    Structured problem-solver who enjoys tackling complex challenges creatively and pragmatically.    A relationship-builder who understands counterparties' perspectives and resolves issues with a positive impact.    Self-driven and proactive — takes initiative, leads projects independently, and continuously seeks to improve.    Resilient and collaborative, thriving in fast-paced environments while keeping internal and external stakeholders aligned.Why join us?At Ingrid, we're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving what matters most. Our culture is built on Bold Impact · Curious Grit · Inspiring Collaboration. We believe a thriving organisation runs on trust, growth, and learning from mistakes — and that wellbeing matters as much as work. From team workouts to social activities, we make space to connect, recharge, and thrive together.Next stepWe’ll make selections on an ongoing basis and finalize the recruitment as soon as we’ve found the perfect match.We look forward to hearing from you!/Team Ingrid

About VolumentalVolumental is a FitTech™ company used by footwear brands and retailers, matching people with shoes that truly fit through 3D scanning and machine learning.Our vision is "a world without sizes, where every body fits". We work with brands like New Balance, Red Wing, Fleet Feet, and Vivobarefoot across 3,000+ stores in 60 countries, with 60M+ foot scans collected, one of the world's largest datasets of its kind.We've always been an AI company at our core. Today, that extends beyond the product into how we build, using AI agents and strong self-serve tooling to move faster from idea to production. Where you fit in  Every scan in every one of those stores, and every recommendation we give, depends on infrastructure that has to work while a shopper is standing in front of a clerk. Our platform runs on Kubernetes on Google Cloud, is managed as code, is deployed through GitOps, and is observed through Grafana. What we’re looking for is someone who treats that platform as a product: one our developers can self-serve on, that holds up when things go wrong, and that is ready for new kinds of workloads.This is a hands-on Platform Engineer role. Most days you'll be shipping and running infrastructure with Terraform, Helm and ArgoCD, keeping an eye on our systems through Grafana, and building tools in Go that let developers get what they need without waiting on anyone. You'll also spend time explaining technical tradeoffs and writing docs that others can act on.AI is changing the industry, and we see it as an opportunity to empower people. By automating toil and mechanical tasks across the organisation, people can focus on the architectural, novel, and creative work. You will be right at the centre of this transformation, enabling not only yourself and your team’s work, but ensuring that the company can leverage AI and accelerate as a whole.Things you'll do:     Ship and run production infrastructure on Kubernetes and GCP, managed as code with Terraform and deployed with Helm and ArgoCD    Define SLOs and build monitoring and alerting in Grafana that tells us when stores and shoppers are actually affected    Take part in on-call, lead incident response, and run postmortems that turn into real fixes    Build tools in Go that let developers self-serve on environments, deployments and access    Explain technical tradeoffs to engineers, product managers and leadership, and write documentation others can act on    Leverage AI agents to compress routine work, redirecting the time saved into reliability and platform improvements    Help strengthen how we handle access, secrets, certificates and image security alongside the wider teamWe are excited about you because:    You have 3+ years of experience running production infrastructure in an SRE, DevOps or Platform role    You've been on-call for production systems on Kubernetes and a major cloud provider, ideally GCP, and have led incident response and postmortems    You can set up SLO-based monitoring and alerting, and you're comfortable managing infrastructure as code with Terraform    You write clean, maintainable, cloud-native code in at least one language such as Go or Python    You have solid systems knowledge and troubleshoot methodically across the stack    You're comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy finding the right problem and seeing it throughBonus - Don't let these stop you from applying, but please let us know if you have experience with:    Deploying and running AI agent workloads and tool servers (such as MCP), with sandboxing, rate limiting and observability of agent actions    Security: identity and access management, authentication (OAuth/OIDC, SSO), certificate and TLS/mTLS management, secrets handling, network hardening, vulnerability management, and image hardening and scanning    Compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 or GDPR    Database operations and migrations    Running workloads across multiple cloud providers or regulated regions What we can offer you:    Personal learning budget and access to coaching    Opportunity to work with a great team of 20+ nationalities in our English-speaking office    Occupational pension at ITP1 level    Flexible Public Holidays Policy    Options Program    Parental pay top-up    Wellness allowance    Flexible work policy (at least 3 days a week from our Stockholm office) The monthly compensation range for this role in Stockholm is 52,000-66,000 SEK. Actual compensation will depend on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process.This is a full-time position based at our Stockholm headquarters. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds! If this role excites you but you don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply - we'd love to hear from you.Feel free to include a link to your GitHub or anything you've built or operated that you're proud of.How we hireWe use generative AI to assist the people running our recruitment process, for example in preparing interviews. People are in the loop at every stage, and every decision about your application is made by a human.
